AC-001.criterion: Given an approved contract, when intake runs, then every required product-truth section is admitted without loss.

API-CONTRACT-INTAKE.purpose: Receive an approved PMOS contract bundle.

ASM-001.statement: Approved PMOS contracts contain no credentials or customer records.
ASM-001.validation_plan: Reject raw secret values and accept only governed references.

CAPABILITY-CONTRACT-INTAKE.description: Receive and structurally admit canonical PMOS contract bundles.

DATA-001.purpose: Trace approved product intent through engineering evidence.
DATA-001.requirement: Retain contract metadata and digests without embedding customer records.

DEP-PMOS.description: PM Agent OS publishes approved product truth.

EXT-CONSTRAINT-001.rationale: The repository extension cannot change ownership of product truth.

FR-001.statement: Accept one canonical PMOS contract bundle without inventing missing product truth.
FR-001.title: Canonical contract intake

GUARD-SECURITY-001.description: Contracts must contain references to secrets, never secret values.

METRIC-LEAD-001.definition: Share of received bundles that pass structural validation on first submission.
METRIC-LEAD-001.name: First-pass contract validation rate

target.baseline_plan: Approve a prospective EADPR target after the first fixed due cohort matures.
Approve a prospective first-pass validation target after the initial intake cohort.
Approve a prospective VAPDR target after the first fixed production due cohort matures.

end_state.definition: Percentage of approved contract slices deployed with acceptance, SLO, and evidence gates satisfied without manual code modification.
end_state.name: Verified autonomous production delivery rate

mvp.definition: Percentage of approved contracts that produce a green, traceable, evidence-backed draft PR without manual engineering handholding.
mvp.name: Evidence-backed autonomous draft PR rate

POLICY-REPORTING-END-STATE.calculation: Count eligible production-due slices meeting every acceptance, SLO, evidence, and autonomy condition divided by the fixed eligible denominator.
POLICY-REPORTING-END-STATE.denominator: Approved contract slices whose production delivery window closed in the reporting cohort.
exclusions: Slices superseded before engineering work began

POLICY-REPORTING-LEADING.calculation: Count first-pass structurally valid received bundles divided by all eligible received bundles.
POLICY-REPORTING-LEADING.denominator: Received bundles whose validation window closed in the reporting cohort.
inclusion_criteria: Validation attempt reached a terminal outcome

POLICY-REPORTING-MVP.calculation: Count eligible approved contracts producing a green, traceable, evidence-backed draft PR without manual engineering handholding divided by the fixed eligible denominator.
POLICY-REPORTING-MVP.denominator: Approved contracts whose draft-PR delivery window closed in the reporting cohort.
exclusions: Contracts revoked before repository work began

METRIC-SUCCESS-001.definition: Approved product truth is admitted without loss or invented decisions.
METRIC-SUCCESS-001.name: Lossless contract admission

NFR-001.evidence_expectation: Deterministic schema and fixture checks pass at the exact commit.
NFR-001.requirement: The same canonical bytes must produce the same validation result.

NFR-LEGACY-CATEGORY.evidence_expectation: The exact source category remains machine-readable after canonical compilation.
NFR-LEGACY-CATEGORY.requirement: Preserve valid legacy non-functional-requirement categories without reinterpretation.

OBS-001.alert_condition: Any admitted bundle lacks a required evidence reference.
OBS-001.requirement: Record contract admission outcomes and stable subject identifiers.

QUESTION-001.question: Which optional repository extensions will be standardized after MVP?
QUESTION-001.resolution: Defer until extension usage evidence exists.

data_residency.cross_border_transfer_policy: No cross-border transfer without a new product and privacy approval.

deletion.trigger: Approved deletion request or contract-retention expiry

PRIV-001.requirement: Do not embed personal records in the contract bundle.

retention.policy: Retain approved contract metadata for the project lifetime or one year, whichever is shorter.

telemetry.purpose: Measure contract admission quality without collecting product payload values.

hypothesis.falsification_condition: Approved bundles still require engineers to infer material product decisions.
hypothesis.statement: A complete canonical contract will reduce manual engineering handholding.

outcome.business_outcome: Engineering delivery becomes faster and more reliable without transferring product decisions to implementers.
outcome.customer_outcome: Product owners can hand an approved contract to engineering without repeated clarification.
outcome.measurable_change: More approved slices reach evidence-backed draft PRs without manual engineering intervention.
outcome.statement: Engineering can begin from explicit, approved, traceable product truth.

problem.affected_customers: Product owners and engineering teams using PM Agent OS.
problem.statement: Separate legacy contracts omit required product truth and use incompatible version semantics.

target_customers: Product owners publishing approved PM Agent OS contracts
Engineering teams consuming approved product truth

target_platform.description: Repository-integrated agentic engineering control plane and CLI.

DECISION-CANONICAL-SCHEMA.decision: Use one canonical versioned PMOS-to-PEOS bundle with a non-weakenable typed core.
DECISION-CANONICAL-SCHEMA.rationale: Lossless compilation and deterministic validation require one explicit boundary contract.

EVAL-LOSSLESSNESS.criterion: Every product-truth field survives canonical compilation without reinterpretation.

QA-001.expectation: Valid and invalid canonical fixtures produce deterministic outcomes.

GOLDEN-CANONICAL-BUNDLE.expected_outcome: The complete approved bundle validates and remains traceable.
GOLDEN-CANONICAL-BUNDLE.scenario: A complete approved PMOS contract enters canonical schema admission.

GATE-SCHEMA.description: Every valid and planted-invalid schema fixture produces its expected deterministic result.

deployment_target.description: Documentation and schema verification on the repository draft-PR surface only.

eligible_audiences: Repository maintainers evaluating the draft contract schema

REL-001.expectation: Open one focused draft PR with exact-head evidence.

APPROVAL-REQ-CONTRACT.purpose: Authorize the exact canonical product-truth bundle before engineering execution.

RISK-001.description: An incomplete schema could falsely admit missing product truth.
RISK-001.mitigation: Require every Phase 0 section and exercise planted invalid fixtures.

rollback.data_loss_tolerance: No rewrite or loss of already registered contract records.

ROLLBACK-001.recovery_evidence: Prior schema remains addressable and registered contracts remain unchanged.
ROLLBACK-001.requirement: Revert the schema PR without rewriting previously registered contracts.
ROLLBACK-001.trigger: Canonical schema admits invalid product truth or breaks declared compatibility.

SEC-001.requirement: Reject embedded credentials and preserve only governed secret references.

CONSTRAINT-001.constraint: Use JSON Schema draft 2020-12 as the normative wire contract.

A11Y-001.requirement: Generated user experiences must satisfy WCAG 2.2 AA.

EDGE-001.condition: A required product decision is absent.
EDGE-001.expected_behavior: Stop with PRODUCT_INPUT_REQUIRED rather than inventing a value.

UX-FLOW-001.goal: Publish an approved contract for engineering intake.
UX-FLOW-001.name: Approve and publish contract

steps.expected_outcome: Approval metadata binds the contract subject.
PEOS receives versioned canonical bytes and provenance.

JOURNEY-STEP-PUBLISH.description: Publish the approved canonical contract bundle.

RESP-001.requirement: Any generated browser experience must remain usable at supported mobile and desktop widths.

SCREEN-CONTRACT-STATUS.name: Contract status
SCREEN-CONTRACT-STATUS.purpose: Show contract admission and blocking-product-input state.

UI-STATE-BLOCKED.description: A required product decision is missing or invalid.

UI-STATE-READY.description: The contract is structurally admitted for engineering validation.

US-001.i_want: to publish one complete approved contract
US-001.so_that: engineering can execute without inventing product truth
